narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: a planet-spanning living network seen as both forest and circuitry at once — the image that captures the central question, is this a mind or a network? A web of glowing root-links beneath a Pandoran forest, vast and patternful, with no single bright centre that would read as a 'self'.
subject: A wide view looking down through a darkened Pandoran forest into the soil beneath it, where a vast lattice of fine glowing root and fungal filaments spreads in every direction like a neural net, countless small nodes where filaments meet lit faintly in cyan, the web continuing past the frame in all directions with no obvious centre; above the soil the dim trunks and hanging fronds of the forest rise into darkness.
scene: The boundary between forest floor and the lit underground network, the canopy a dark ceiling above and the glowing root-mesh receding into hazy depth below.
camera: A three-quarter downward view that shows both the forest above and the luminous network below in one frame, deep perspective into the mesh.
light: Bioluminescent key entirely from the glowing filament-junctions of the network; the forest above lit only by that upward spill; deep indigo shadow everywhere else.
palette: Void-indigo base, dense Pandora cyan and living teal in the network filaments, a single faint warm node or two as rare accent so no warm area competes.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence.
detail_level: Crisp on the nearest network junctions and root filaments; the forest above and the deep mesh dissolving into haze.
composition: Network filling the lower two-thirds spreading edge to edge with no single focal hub, forest as a dark band above, generous hazy depth so the web feels planet-scale and unbounded.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with from-within bioluminescent key; the network must read as distributed and centreless, not as a brain or a single organism — that centrelessness is the chapter's whole thesis.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no single central glowing brain
